mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, we are seeing clear skies near Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 71 degrees. The moon is currently in its third quarter phase. If you are awake, you can spot the International Space Station tonight starting at 4:19 AM; it will rise in the northwest over Verona High School and travel toward Fitchburg, reaching halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has officially installed a new public art sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park. This seven-foot-tall piece was carved from a reclaimed ash tree by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland and celebrates traditional Tai Chi movements.

There is plenty happening in our area, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, followed by Hop Haus Trivia tonight. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, with the Dane County Farmers Market returning this Friday.

Regarding the police report for the week, on August 28, officers responded to a report of ding-dong-ditching in the areas of Church Avenue and South Marietta Street, where two juveniles were located and warned for their actions.
Today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. Please note that the restaurant is closed right now but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
